study_identification_part.si4_title: Neurofind: using deep learning to make individualised inferences in brain-based disorders

study_characteristics_part.sc1_study_objective: Introduce Neurofind, a freely available web tool that applies data harmonisation and normative modeling to structural MRI to compute an Outlier Index Score (deviation from normative morphology) and Brain Age; demonstrate exemplar applications in Alzheimer's disease and schizophrenia.

rci1_dataset_name.answer: HCP Young Adults; HCP Aging; UK Biobank; IXI
rci1_dataset_name.reason: The training/reference cohort comprises healthy controls drawn from four public datasets explicitly listed in the Methods.
rci1_dataset_name.supporting_text: Data for training the web-based normative models used in Neurofind consisted of four publicly available datasets of healthy controls, namely the Human Connectome Project, the Human Connectome Project Aging, Biobank and IXI.

rci2_hc_n.reason: Final number of healthy controls in the training set is reported after QC, balancing, and outlier removal.
rci2_hc_n.supporting_text: The final data for the train set comprised 3362 participants (Fig. 1, Table 1, Supplementary Materials for sample size/scanner).

rci3_hc_age.reason: Table 1 provides median and IQR. Inclusion criteria specify ages 20–80. Mean/SD not reported.
rci3_hc_age.supporting_text: Table 1. Demographic characteristics of the train set... Age, median [Q1, Q3] 52.0 [15.2]. Participants younger than 20 and older than 80 years old were excluded.

rci4_hc_sex.reason: Sex distribution is given in Table 1 for the training set.

rci5_imaging_modality.reason: Only high-resolution structural T1-weighted MRI was used for preprocessing and modeling.
rci5_imaging_modality.supporting_text: The initial total sample included 13,918 T1-weighted MRI images from 7 scanners.

rci6_analysis_level.supporting_text: The cortical surface was parcellated using the Desikan-Killiany cortical atlas... An additional 33 neuroanatomical structures... totalling 101 brain regions (ROIs).

rci7_preprocessing_pipeline.answer: MRIQC; FreeSurfer v6.0; Desikan-Killiany atlas; ASEG; ROI volumes normalised by ICV
rci7_preprocessing_pipeline.reason: Explicitly describes MRIQC QC threshold, FreeSurfer recon-all v6.0, parcellation/segmentation and ICV normalisation.
rci7_preprocessing_pipeline.supporting_text: Poor quality images were excluded based on the MRIQC tool... Images with a probability higher than 0.7 were discarded. ... recon-all pipeline... FreeSurfer (version 6.0)... Desikan-Killiany... ASEG... We estimated the relative brain region volumes ... by dividing ... by the total intracranial volume.

rci8_quality_checking.detail: MRIQC probability >0.7 exclusion; per-scanner iterative outlier removal if ≥10 ROIrel >3 SD from mean; UK Biobank age-bin undersampling (≤55 per age group); final train N=3362.
rci8_quality_checking.supporting_text: Images with a probability higher than 0.7 were discarded... healthy controls... with at least 10 ROIrel more than 3 standard deviations... were considered outliers and excluded... implemented within each scanner... The largest scanner of the Biobank dataset was under-sampled such that a maximum of 55 participants per age group were selected at random.

rci9_site_effect_handling.detail: Neuroharmony predicted ComBat-style additive/multiplicative corrections from MRIQC IQMs; trained controlling for age and sex for Outlier model and sex-only for Brain Age; trained on the same training datasets.
rci9_site_effect_handling.supporting_text: Neuroharmony was trained twice... For the former, Neuroharmony was trained whilst controlling for the effects of age and sex, whereas for Brain Age, only sex was added as a covariate. Neuroharmony was trained in the same train datasets as used for the development...

nm1_model_origin.supporting_text: The tool was trained on 3362 images of healthy controls aged 20–80 from publicly available datasets.

nm2_modeling_method.answer: Deep Learning (Adversarial Autoencoder) for Outlier Index; Linear Support Vector Regression for Brain Age
nm2_modeling_method.reason: Methods sections specify AAE for deviation modeling and SVR for brain age prediction.
nm2_modeling_method.supporting_text: ... modelled with an adversarial autoencoder for the Outlier index model and a support vector regression for the Brain age model.

nm3_software_tool.answer: Python scikit-learn (SVR); custom AAE implementation; Neuroharmony for harmonisation
nm3_software_tool.reason: SVR implementation is explicitly scikit-learn; AAE framework not specified; harmonisation uses Neuroharmony.
nm3_software_tool.supporting_text: ... linear support vector regression (SVR) model as implemented in the Python package scikit-learn... Scanner effects... mitigated using the Neuroharmony method.

nm4_response_variable.answer: ROI-level volumes (101 cortical/subcortical regions) normalised by ICV; overall and ROI-level reconstruction errors (OIS); predicted brain age
nm4_response_variable.reason: They extract 101 ROI volumes and derive OIS (scaled reconstruction error) and brain age from these features.
nm4_response_variable.supporting_text: ... totalling 101 brain regions (ROIs)... The reconstruction error for each ROIrel... An overall reconstruction error... named Outlier Index Score (OIS)... To predict brain age, harmonised and scaled ROIrel ... inputted to a linear SVR.

nm5_predictor_variables.answer: ROIrel (ICV-normalised ROI volumes); harmonisation covariates: Age; Sex (age+sex for Outlier; sex-only for Brain Age)
nm5_predictor_variables.reason: For Brain Age, predictors are ROI features; Outlier model is unsupervised on ROI features; harmonisation includes covariates controlling nuisance effects.
nm5_predictor_variables.supporting_text: ... ROIrel from the train set... Neuroharmony was trained whilst controlling for the effects of age and sex (Outlier)... for Brain Age, only sex was added as a covariate.

nm6_predictor_effects.answer: No explicit fixed/random effects; nuisance covariates handled in harmonisation (age+sex or sex-only); AAE unsupervised; SVR supervised
nm6_predictor_effects.reason: No mixed-effects modeling; nuisance structure addressed via batch harmonisation with covariates.
nm6_predictor_effects.supporting_text: Scanner effects... mitigated using Neuroharmony... controlling for the effects of age and sex (Outlier) and sex-only (Brain Age).

nm7_nm_vldtn_handle_ns.reason: They mitigate scanner/site effects via Neuroharmony; apply MRIQC-based QC; normalise ROI volumes by ICV; balance age distribution; thus addressing mean/variance shifts and measurement artefacts.
nm7_nm_vldtn_handle_ns.supporting_text: Scanner effects... mitigated using the Neuroharmony method... MRIQC tool... Images with a probability higher than 0.7 were discarded... dividing by total intracranial volume... under-sampled Biobank age groups.

nm8_nm_vldtn_same_domain_nonindep.reason: For Brain Age, they conducted 10-fold cross-validated hyperparameter selection within the training data (non-independent). For OIS/AAE, explicit same-domain validation metrics are not detailed beyond scaling and distribution checks.
nm8_nm_vldtn_same_domain_nonindep.supporting_text: A systematic hyperparameter search for C was conducted using a ten-fold cross-validated grid-search... The C value with the best performance... In the train set, the MAE was 10.5 ± 9.8 years.

nm9_nm_vldtn_same_domain_indep.reason: No independent held-out validation set from the same domain is reported for either model.

nm10_nm_vldtn_diff_domain.reason: They applied the models to independent clinical datasets (AIBL, MCIC, COBRE) not used in training, and reported group differences and ROI-level effects.
nm10_nm_vldtn_diff_domain.supporting_text: Exemplar applications were carried out in three clinical datasets: AIBL, MCIC and COBRE... The final data comprised 364 participants in the clinical datasets (Fig. 3, Table 2).

caa1_clinical_dataset.reason: Datasets for exemplar clinical applications are explicitly listed.
caa1_clinical_dataset.supporting_text: Exemplar applications were carried out in three clinical datasets: the Australian Imaging, Biomarkers and Lifestyle Study (AIBL), the MIND Clinical Imaging Consortium (MCIC) and the Center for Biomedical Research Excellence (COBRE) dataset.

caa2_diseases_studied.reason: AIBL includes AD; MCIC and COBRE include SZ.
caa2_diseases_studied.supporting_text: The AIBL dataset includes patients diagnosed with AD... the latter two datasets include patients diagnosed with SZ...

caa3_clinical_groups_n.reason: Table 2 reports group sizes. Controls were 61 (AD HC) and 111 (SZ HC).
caa3_clinical_groups_n.supporting_text: Table 2... AD (N = 61) vs HC (N = 61); SZ (N = 134) vs HC (N = 111)

caa4_clinical_groups_age.reason: Table 2 provides median and IQR for ages in each group.

caa5_clinical_groups_sex.reason: Sex distributions per group are reported in Table 2.
caa5_clinical_groups_sex.supporting_text: Table 2... Sex F/M, N (%) ... AD 37/24; HC 43/18; SZ 30/104; HC 32/79 (percentages shown).

caa6_deviation_metric.answer: Outlier Index Score (OIS): scaled reconstruction error in IQR units with thresholds (<0.26 within norm; ≥0.26 low; ≥1.1 medium; ≥2.3 high); Brain Age Gap (BAG)
caa6_deviation_metric.reason: OIS definition and thresholds are in Methods; BAG defined and used in analyses.
caa6_deviation_metric.supporting_text: The final scaled errors, which we named Outlier Index Score (OIS)... The OIS is categorised into: Within the norm (<0.26), Low (≥0.26), Medium (≥1.1) and High (≥2.3)... BAG was calculated by subtracting the chronological age from the predicted brain age and normalised according to the train set.

clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa7_association_analysis: Group comparisons (independent t-test or Mann–Whitney) for OIS and BAG; ROI-level tests with Benjamini–Hochberg FDR; correlations between OIS/BAG and clinical scales (MMSE in AD; SAPS/SANS and PANSS in SZ) using Pearson or Spearman; bootstrapped 95% CIs for ROI-level effects.
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa8_key_findings_brief: AD shows large deviations from normative morphology with many high outliers and homogeneous deviation patterns; SZ shows fewer extreme outliers and more heterogeneity; both groups exhibit accelerated brain ageing.
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa9_key_findings_detailed: AD had significantly higher OIS than controls (Median 2.46 [IQR 2.50] vs 0.91 [1.36]; Mann–U=1361; p<0.001) with larger deviations in bilateral amygdala, hippocampus, inferior temporal gyri, inferior lateral ventricles, and left inferior parietal gyrus after FDR correction. 55.2% of AD patients were classified as high deviation versus 13.8% of controls. SZ showed no significant difference in overall OIS (Median 1.38 [1.83] vs 1.10 [1.76]; p=0.091) but exhibited larger deviations in bilateral hippocampus and left putamen. 30.1% of SZ patients were extreme outliers. Both AD and SZ groups showed increased BAG relative to controls (accelerated brain ageing).
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa11_application_notes: Recommend including local healthy controls alongside patients to control sample-specific biases; OIS thresholds derived from training distribution enable individual-level interpretation.

caa10_key_limitations.answer: Tool not customisable; designed for research, not clinical decision-making. Brain age model did not account for age bias; analyses should adjust for chronological age. Neuroharmony requires IQMs within the training range; performance may degrade for unusual image qualities. Potential limited generalisability outside ages 20–80, non-white ethnicities, or MRI field strengths far from 1.5T/3T.

general_note_part.gn1_general_notes: Supplementary materials provide scanner parameters (Table S1) and full ROI lists (Table S2). Code availability: https://github.com/MLMH-Lab/neurofind_ai. Training initially included 13,918 T1 MRIs; after QC and balancing, train N=3362. OIS computed from AAE reconstruction errors scaled to IQR; ROI volumes normalised by ICV.
